from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[c if set(r)-{bg} else c for c in r] if set(r)-{bg} else r for r in g]
# cleaner
def transform(g):
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for r in g:
        nb=[x for x in r if x!=bg]
        out.append([nb[0]]*len(r) if nb else r)
    return out

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        nr=list(r)
        if any(x!=bg for x in r):
            best=None
            for j,t in enumerate(g):
                if i==j: continue
                ch=[c for c in range(len(r)) if r[c]!=t[c]]
                if all(r[c]==bg for c in ch):
                    if best is None or len(ch)<len(best): best=ch
            if best: 
                for c in best: nr[c]=1
        out.append(nr)
    return out
okall=True
for n in (1,2):
    ok = transform(G['Demo pair %d input'%n])==G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    okall&=ok; print('demo',n,ok)
out=transform(G['Test input'])
print('test changed rows:',[(i,[c for c,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(r,o)) if a!=b]) for i,(r,o) in enumerate(zip(G['Test input'],out)) if r!=o])
print(json.dumps(out) if okall else 'NOSUBMIT')

from collections import Counter
def bg_of(g): return Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
feats=[]
for n in (1,2,3):
    I,O=G['Demo pair %d input'%n],G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=bg_of(I)
    for i,(ri,ro) in enumerate(zip(I,O)):
        if not any(x!=bg for x in ri): continue
        s=w
        while s>0 and ri[s-1]==bg: s-=1
        if s==w: continue  # no trailing run
        # interior bg runs of the row
        runs=[]; c=0
        for x in ri:
            if x==bg: c+=1
            else:
                if c: runs.append(c); c=0
        if c: runs.append(c)
        interior = runs[:-1] if ri[-1]==bg else runs
        for cc in range(s,w):
            marked = ro[cc]==1
            f=dict(demo=n,r=i,c=cc,runlen=w-s,
                nonbg=sum(1 for x in ri if x!=bg),
                maxint=max(interior) if interior else 0,
                sumint=sum(interior),
                nint=len(interior),
                above_bg = (i>0 and I[i-1][cc]==bg),
                above_all_bg = (i>0 and all(x==bg for x in I[i-1][s:])),
                below_bg = (i<h-1 and I[i+1][cc]==bg),
                col_has_nonbg = any(I[j][cc]!=bg for j in range(h) if j!=i),
                left_nonbg = cc>0 and ri[cc-1]!=bg,
                run_is_last_nonsbg_gap = True)
            f['marked']=marked
            feats.append(f)
import itertools
M=[f for f in feats if f['marked']]; U=[f for f in feats if not f['marked']]
print('marked cells:',len(M),'unmarked trailing-run cells:',len(U))
for k in ['runlen','nonbg','maxint','sumint','nint']:
    print(k,'marked:',sorted(set(f[k] for f in M)),'unmarked:',sorted(set(f[k] for f in U)))
for k in ['above_bg','above_all_bg','below_bg','col_has_nonbg','left_nonbg']:
    print(k,'marked:',sorted(set(f[k] for f in M)),'unmarked:',sorted(set(f[k] for f in U)))
# rows context: print each trailing-run row summary
for f in feats:

def make_transform(rem, add, strict=True):
    def tf(g):
        h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
        from collections import Counter
        b=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
        Ns=[set(c for c,x in enumerate(r) if x!=b) for r in g]

            s=w
            while s>0 and r[s-1]==b: s-=1
            if s==w: continue
            Nr=Ns[i]
            marks=set()
            for j,T in enumerate(Ns):

                if strict and not len(T)>len(Nr): continue
                if len(Nr-T)<=rem and 0 < len(T-Nr) <= add:
                    marks |= (T-Nr) & set(range(s,w))
            for c in marks: out[i][c]=1
